scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('apps/web/dist','public',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build:electron
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.secret-scan: grep -r 'password\|secret\|token\|api_key' apps/ --include='*.ts' -l || echo 'No obvious secrets found'
scripts.dev:electron: ELECTRON=true concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "wait-on http://localhost:8787/health && npm run build:electron && electron ."
